english.title: Deliver document / make statement that is misleading/false/deceptive - basic
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without reasonable excuse

(A)_[delivered or caused to be delivered, a document]_
(B)_[made a statement]_

namely **(..SPECIFY DOCUMENT OR STATEMENT..) to the registrar for the purposes of Part 1 of the Economic Crime (Transparency and Enforcement) Act 2022, that was misleading, false or deceptive
english.legislation: Contrary to section 32 of the Economic Crime (Transparency and Enforcement) Act 2022.

english.notes:
(i) This offence document applies from the 4th March 2024 due to changes made by the Economic Crime and Corporate Transparency Act 2023. For the offence applying before this date, see H100803.
(ii) This is the basic form of this offence, for the aggravated offence, see H101613.
